note: Prosperity 2nd Edition (2022) — 25 kingdom cards transcribed from the official rulebook, plus the two base cards Colony and Platinum. Colony and Platinum join the Supply whenever a Prosperity kingdom card is used (Colony 8 at 2p / 12 at 3+; Platinum always 12). The Colony pile emptying also ends the game. Effects are implemented in later roadmap tasks; data is pinned here.

cards.name: Colony
cards.text: Worth 10 VP.

cards.name: Platinum
cards.text: +5 Coins.

cards.name: Anvil
cards.text: +$1. You may discard a Treasure to gain a card costing up to $4.

cards.name: Bank
cards.text: +$1 per Treasure card you have in play (counting this).

cards.name: Bishop
cards.text: +$1; +1 VP token. Trash a card from your hand. +1 VP per $2 it costs (round down). Each other player may trash a card from their hand.

cards.name: Charlatan
cards.text: +$2; each other player gains a Curse. In games using this, Curse is also a Treasure worth $1.

cards.name: City
cards.text: +1 Card; +2 Actions. If there are one or more empty Supply piles, +1 Card. If there are two or more, +1 Buy and +$1.

cards.name: Clerk
cards.text: +$2; each other player with 5 or more cards in hand puts one onto their deck. At the start of your turn, you may play this from your hand.

cards.name: Collection
cards.text: +1 Buy. This turn, when you gain an Action card, +$1.

cards.name: Crystal Ball
cards.text: Look at the top card of your deck. You may trash it, discard it, or, if it's an Action or Treasure, play it.

cards.name: Expand
cards.text: Trash a card from your hand. Gain a card costing up to 3 more than it.

cards.name: Forge
cards.text: Trash any number of cards from your hand. Gain a card with cost exactly equal to the total cost of the trashed cards.

cards.name: Grand Market
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action; +1 Buy; +$2. You can't buy this if you have any Coppers in play.

cards.name: Hoard
cards.text: Worth $2. When you buy a Victory card, gain a Gold.

cards.name: Investment
cards.text: Trash a card from your hand. Choose one: +$2; or trash this to reveal your hand for +$1 per differently named Treasure there.

cards.name: King's Court
cards.text: You may play an Action card from your hand three times.

cards.name: Magnate
cards.text: Reveal your hand. +1 Card per Treasure in it.

cards.name: Mint
cards.text: You may reveal a Treasure card from your hand. Gain a copy of it. When you gain this, trash all non-Duration Treasures you have in play.

cards.name: Monument
cards.text: +$2; +1 VP token.

cards.name: Peddler
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action; +$1. During a player's Buy phase, this costs $2 less per Action card they have in play.

cards.name: Quarry
cards.text: This turn, Actions cost $1 less.

cards.name: Rabble
cards.text: +3 Cards. Each other player reveals the top 3 cards of their deck, discards the Actions and Treasures, and puts the rest back in any order they choose.

cards.name: Tiara
cards.text: +1 Buy. This turn, when you gain a card, you may put it onto your deck. You may play a Treasure from your hand twice.

cards.name: Vault
cards.text: +2 Cards. Discard any number of cards for +$1 each. Each other player may discard 2 cards, to draw a card.

cards.name: War Chest
cards.text: The player to your left names a card. Gain a card costing up to $5 that hasn't been named for War Chests this turn.

cards.name: Watchtower
cards.text: Draw until you have 6 cards in hand. When you gain a card, you may reveal this from your hand, to either trash that card or put it onto your deck.

cards.name: Worker's Village
cards.text: +1 Card; +2 Actions; +1 Buy.
